title: ITVX / Letterform specimen
slide_intent: Compare letterform character at display scale before applying it to full headlines, because letterforms shape the tone and reading emphasis of a message.
strategic_value: This approach can strengthen a recognizable voice across different programme moods.
demonstration: A printed specimen leans against a wall with two oversized K forms in yellow and white on a dark field. Small supporting text sits at the lower right.
practical_value: Compare letterform character at display scale before applying it to full headlines.
